title: Introducing OpenDesign Arena
body:
Over a dozen models tested: Compare design quality and cost across models evaluated with the OpenDesign Harness.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Leads in Scores: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash achieved 98% of top-ranked GPT-6 Astra’s average score at just 1% of its average cost.
Find the right model for you: Explore the benchmarks to choose a model for your design needs and budget.

zh-CN.title: OpenDesign Arena 正式上线
zh-CN.body:
十多款模型实测：使用 OpenDesign Harness，对比模型的设计表现与成本。
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 评分领先：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的均分达到榜首 GPT-6 Astra 的 98%，平均成本仅为其 1%。
找到适合你的模型：前往 Arena，根据创作需求与预算选择模型。
